title: What Side Of The Intelligence Spectrum Are You On?
summary: Words, patterns, people, music, movement and nature reveal the intelligence style your mind prefers.

landing.intro: Words, patterns, people, rhythm, movement or the natural world—follow your instincts to reveal how your mind connects best.

about.body:
This personality quiz maps everyday preferences onto eight intelligence-inspired spectrum styles. Across ten rounds, it explores how you naturally approach language, patterns, reflection, sound, people, movement, visual space and the living world. It is a preference profile, not a test of ability.

The eight results take inspiration from the multiple-intelligences framework associated with Howard Gardner. Gardner originally proposed seven intelligences and later recognised naturalist intelligence as an eighth; existential intelligence has been discussed as a possible candidate ninth but is not scored here. This quiz does not claim to reproduce a formal assessment, and Gardner has not endorsed a self-report multiple-intelligences test.

Your final result highlights a primary and secondary spectrum style based on the complete pattern of your choices. The orientation shown is a playful label attached to each quiz profile; it is not separately assessed and is not part of Gardner’s theory. This quiz maps preferences—it does not measure the strength of any intelligence.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Choose the response that feels naturally closest to you; there are no right or wrong answers.
Move through all ten rounds, including two reflection scales and the Brainwave Sprint.
Complete the Spectrum Mirror to reveal your primary style, secondary style and quiz orientation.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. This quiz is not an IQ test, educational diagnosis or psychological assessment.

profiles.title: The Story Architect
profiles.copy: You naturally turn experience into language. Reading, writing and storytelling help you shape ideas, catch nuance and give other people a clear way into what you mean.

profiles.title: The Pattern Strategist
profiles.copy: Your mind looks for structure beneath the surface. Numbers, logic, patterns and problem-solving become tools for testing ideas and finding a route that genuinely holds together.

profiles.title: The Inner Compass
profiles.copy: You understand life by checking in with your inner world. Reflection, self-awareness and careful attention to your own emotions help you make choices that feel honest rather than automatic.

profiles.title: The Rhythm Decoder
profiles.copy: You are unusually alert to rhythm, tone and emotional sound. Whether listening, composing or noticing patterns in music, you often hear structure before other people know it is there.

profiles.title: The People Reader
profiles.copy: You think especially well through human connection. Empathy, communication and reading other people help you understand what a room needs and bring different perspectives together.

profiles.title: The Hands-On Dynamo
profiles.copy: Your thinking comes alive through movement and direct experience. Coordination, hands-on skills and physical practice help an idea become real, memorable and useful.

profiles.title: The Visual Navigator
profiles.copy: You organise ideas as pictures, spaces and routes. Visualisation, design and navigating the world feel intuitive because you can mentally turn a problem and view it from another angle.

profiles.title: The Living-World Connector
profiles.copy: You notice relationships across the living world. Recognising, categorising and connecting with nature helps you see how details belong to a larger system.

profileReveal.disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. This quiz maps everyday preferences onto eight intelligence-inspired styles. It does not measure the strength of any intelligence, IQ, aptitude, introversion or extroversion, and it is not an educational or psychological assessment. The quiz orientation is a playful profile label, not a separate personality assessment.
